newsitem.title: FINLAND: Energy sector boosts Finnish Oct industrial output.
newsitem.headline: Energy sector boosts Finnish Oct industrial output.

text.p: Finnish industrial output growth accelerated to 6.8 percent year-on-year in October helped by a 20.9 percent year-on-year rise in energy sector output, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.
"Energy exports to Sweden increased and simultaneously imports have been replaced by domestic production," SF said.
Forest industry output growth accelerated to 6.8 percent year-on-year in October after rising 3.1 percent year-on-year in September, which was the first growth month since August 1995. @

"Production of pulp, paper and paper products increased over seven percent after rising only three percent in September," SF said. Mechanical forest industry production rose over five percent in October, it added.
Metal industry production increased 6.8 percent in October from the year-ago period.
Production picked up in all metal industry branches excluding the vehicle industry. Growth was fastest in manufacturing of machinery and equipment, up almost 12 percent.
In January-October industrial output rose three percent year-on-year, SF said.
